PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.SUMMARY: Synapse is now a credible developer-tool beta with strong MyGRACE integrity, real Linux/macOS release/install coverage, Node 24-ready GitHub Actions, and hardened MCP/bootstrap/index lifecycle behavior. Remaining readiness risk is concentrated in public documentation truth, release metadata discipline, and supply-chain warning policy.

EVIDENCE.MYGRACE_DRIFT: 0 canonical drift across 70 code modules, graph shards, and verification shards
EVIDENCE.CI_GATE: Full scripts/ci.sh gate passes, including fmt, clippy, runtime guard, tests, release smoke, verify, review, refresh, and status
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_SMOKE: GitHub release run 26120421918 built Linux x86_64, Linux aarch64, macOS x86_64, and macOS arm64 artifacts, aggregated SHA256SUMS, and published v2.3.5 through Node 24-ready release actions and CLI artifact download
EVIDENCE.INSTALLER_TRUTH: Public main installer installed v2.3.5 from the Linux x86_64 release artifact with SHA256 verification; installer maps Linux/macOS x86_64 and arm64 hosts to declared prebuilt artifacts and keeps cargo source fallback
EVIDENCE.ACTIONS_RUNTIME: Hosted main CI run 26120689647 and release run 26120421918 completed with no Node.js 20, DEP0040, DEP0005, or deprecation log markers
EVIDENCE.PHASE7_GATE: Local Phase-7 hardening gate passed: 74 tests, clippy -D warnings, runtime guard, release smoke, verify --ci, review --mode full, refresh drift=0, and scripts/ci.sh
EVIDENCE.MCP_PROTOCOL: syn mcp keeps stdout protocol-clean and JSON-RPC notifications silent
EVIDENCE.INDEX_LIFECYCLE: Full re-index removes deleted-file search entries and syn index --no-git is covered by regression tests
EVIDENCE.BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG: syn init followed by syn doctor accepts built-in default config on clean machines, and existing OpenCode MCP siblings survive Synapse config merge

RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_WINDOWS_DEFERRED: Windows prebuilt install remains intentionally deferred beyond Phase-5
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_NON_DEVELOPER_INSTALL: Non-Linux/macOS users still require source fallback or future platform artifacts
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_DOC_TRUTH: Some public docs still need a strict product-truth pass for ghost commands, obsolete install URLs, and stale metrics
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_RELEASE_DISCIPLINE: Release workflow still needs tag/version guard and non-empty release notes policy
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_SUPPLY_CHAIN_WARNING: cargo audit still reports the allowed unmaintained transitive instant warning via notify 7.0.0

PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.NEXT_PHASE: Phase-8 Product Truth and Release Discipline
